A custom tag of the site (fact box, quote, underline ...): a box around paragraphs or a mark on text, with its own attributes.
A heading, level 1 to 6 (Ctrl+1 ... Ctrl+6). The level follows the order of the headings.
A link to an address, an object or node of the site, an e-mail address or an anchor.
A name links can point to with #name.
A named place in the text that links can point to; shown as a small anchor.
A paragraph. Enter starts a new one, Shift+Enter a new line in it.
A summary is text only: images, embedded objects, tables and custom tags stay in the original text.

Address and attributes of the link.

An embedded image, object or file; in a line of its own or inside the text. Shown with its preview.
Apply anyway takes the text as listed; or change the source.

Bulleted and numbered lists and their items, also nested.
Center the paragraph, heading or table cell, or remove the alignment.
Choose a character to insert it at the cursor.

Embed a file: search, browse or upload it, then choose how it is shown.
Embed an image: search, browse or upload it, then choose its size, alignment, view and class.

Find a word or text and replace it, one by one or all at once.

Insert a column after the one at the cursor.
Insert a column before the one at the cursor.
Insert a custom tag, or edit the one at the cursor: select text first to put it into the tag, choose the tag and fill in its attributes.
Insert a non-breaking space: the words on both sides stay on one line (Ctrl+Shift+Space).
Insert a page break (the custom tag "pagebreak").
Insert a row above the one at the cursor.
Insert a row below the one at the cursor.
Insert a table, or edit the table at the cursor: width, border, class and custom attributes.
Insert or edit a named anchor, which links can point to with #name.
Justify the paragraph, heading or table cell: every line gets the same width.
Leave empty to remove the link.
Literal text, kept exactly as typed.
Literal text: shown exactly as it is typed, for code or preformatted text.
Make a bulleted list. Enter adds an item, Enter on an empty item ends the list. Inside a list the button removes it.
Make a numbered list. Enter adds an item, Enter on an empty item ends the list. Inside a list the button removes it.
Make the selected text a link, or edit the link at the cursor: address (also an object or node of the site, chosen with search or browse), target, title, class, view and custom attributes.
Make the selected text bold. If it is bold already, the formatting is removed.
Make the selected text italic. If it is italic already, the formatting is removed.
Merge the selected cells into one (select cells with Shift+click or by dragging across them).

Move the custom tag up or down
Move the list item one level down (into a nested list).
Move the list item one level up (out of a nested list).

Paste as text: while it is on, everything is pasted without formatting. Ctrl+Shift+V does it for one paste.
Percentage with %, or a number for pixels

Remove bold, italic, links and other formatting from the selected text.
Remove the link at the cursor; its text stays.
Right click (or Shift+F10) for the commands at the cursor; Ctrl+right click for the browser's own menu.
Search, browse or upload the content to embed, then choose how it is shown.
Select text inside one table cell, or text outside the table.
Select the text and copy it with Ctrl+C.

Size and attributes of the new table.
Split a merged cell into its cells again.

Store the draft and continue in the other editor.

Tables with rows, header and data cells; cells can be merged.
